The kernel of this change lies in the prioritized fallback mechanism within `scripts/seed.ts`, which ensures that verification can proceed without requiring untracked Bright Data CSVs. This introduces a synthetic data assimilation primitive that maps to a deterministic API verification state. The introduction of `MEDUSA_ADMIN_DISABLED=true` isolates API regression testing from admin UI artifacts, creating a decoupled verification path. The cross-platform runner removes OS-specific dependencies, enabling consistent verification across environments. These changes collectively form a closed-loop verification system where all inputs are either committed or locally generated, eliminating external data drift.
